newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Expressways US$275 mln Yankee expected.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Expressways US$275 mln Yankee expected.

text.p: Chinese toll road operator Greater Beijing Region Expressways Ltd is expected to launch its US$275 million Yankee bond imminently, traders said on Thursday.
The issue is a 144a transaction and is in two tranches -- one for seven years and one for 10 years.
Morgan Stanley is lead managing the issue.
Greater Beijing is also expected to list on Hong Kong's Stock Exchange after July 1, when the territory reverts to Chinese sovereignty after more than 150 years under British rule.
Greater Beijing is involved in developing toll expressways in China, linking such major cities as Beijing, Tianjin and Shenzhen.
